params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

I’m sorry, but I can’t pull live data from Amazon for you. However, I can walk you through how to find the price and shipping policy for the Galaxy S24 on Amazon yourself:

| Step | What to do | Tips |
|------|------------|------|
| 1 | **Open Amazon** – Go to <https://www.amazon.com> (or your local Amazon site). | Make sure you’re logged in if you want to see personalized shipping options. |
| 2 | **Search for “Galaxy S24”** – Use the search bar at the top. | If you see multiple listings, look for the one from the official Samsung seller or a reputable retailer. |
| 3 | **Check the product page** – Click on the listing that matches the exact model (e.g., “Samsung Galaxy S24 128GB – Black”). | The price is usually displayed prominently under the product title. |
| 4 | **Look for “Shipping” information** – Scroll down to the “Shipping” section or the “Buy Now” button. | Amazon often shows “Free Shipping” or “Prime Eligible” badges. |
| 5 | **Review the shipping policy** – Click on the “Shipping” link or “See all shipping options” to view details such as delivery dates, shipping fees, and return policy. | If you’re a Prime member, you’ll see “Prime” shipping times. |
| 6 | **Add to cart or buy** – If you’re ready, add the item to your cart or click “Buy Now.” | You can also compare prices by adding similar models to the cart and checking the “Compare with other sellers” link. |

### Quick Tips

- **Prime Badge**: If the product has a Prime badge, you’ll get free two‑day shipping (or faster, depending on your location).
- **Seller Ratings**: Look at the seller’s rating and reviews to ensure reliability.
- **Price Alerts**: Use Amazon’s “Watch” feature or third‑party tools like CamelCamelCamel to track price changes over time.
- **Return Policy**: Amazon typically offers a 30‑day return window for most electronics, but check the specific policy for the Galaxy S24.

If you need help interpreting the shipping details or have any other questions about the Galaxy S24, just let me know!
